antimatter.condition: Tier 1 Antimatter Dimension production; Doom active, fewer than 1 Divinity, Compression inactive.
antimatter.penalty: Above the start, replace log10(production) with 1e150 * (log10(production) / 1e150)^0.5.

antimatter.condition: Tier 1 Antimatter Dimension production; Doom active, fewer than 1 Divinity, Compression inactive. Applied after the ee150 stage.
antimatter.penalty: Above the start, replace log10(production) with 1e225 * (log10(production) / 1e225)^0.1.

antimatter.condition: Tier 1 Antimatter Dimension production; Doom active, at least 1 Divinity, Compression inactive.
antimatter.penalty: Above the start, replace log10(production) with 9e15 * (log10(production) / 9e15)^(0.16 / 2^Divinities).

antimatter.condition: Tier 1 Antimatter Dimension production; Doom active and Compression inactive.
antimatter.penalty: Production is transformed using (log10(log10(production)))^(DivinityUpgrade divineL1U4 effect * Cosmic Accelerator effectValue3); both effects determine the effective strength.

antimatter.condition: Tier 1 Antimatter Dimension production; Doom inactive, Overcharge inactive, Slabdrill not cursed, Compression inactive.
antimatter.penalty: Above the start, replace log10(production) with 1e200 * (log10(production) / 1e200)^(1 / Emptiness Accelerator effectValue3).

antimatter.condition: Same conditions as the ee200 stage. Applied after the ee200 stage.
antimatter.penalty: Above the start, replace log10(production) with 1e260 * (log10(production) / 1e260)^0.01.

antimatter.condition: Tier 1 Antimatter Dimension production; Slabdrill is cursed and Compression inactive.
antimatter.penalty: Above the start, replace log10(production) with 2e99 * (log10(production) / 2e99)^0.1.

antimatter.condition: Tier 1 Antimatter Dimension production while the Large Hadron Collider's Nullified Void is running; Compression inactive.
antimatter.penalty: Above the start, replace log10(production) with log10(production)^0.01.

antimatter.condition: Tier 1 Antimatter Dimension production while Overcharge is running; Compression inactive.
antimatter.penalty: Production is tetrated with base 10 at 0.75 * slog(production).

infinityDimensionMultiplier.condition: Infinity Dimension multiplier reaches the overflow threshold.
infinityDimensionMultiplier.penalty: Log-space compression: multiplier = 10^(log10(threshold) * (log10(multiplier) / log10(threshold))^(1 / compressionMagnitude)); base magnitude is 10 and Endgame effects can reduce it.

infinityDimensionMultiplier.condition: Infinity Dimension multiplier reaches the second overflow threshold.
infinityDimensionMultiplier.penalty: A second log-space compression with magnitude 10.

timeDimensionMultiplier.condition: Time Dimension multiplier reaches the overflow threshold.
timeDimensionMultiplier.penalty: Log-space compression with base magnitude 10; Endgame effects can reduce the magnitude.

timeDimensionMultiplier.starts: ENUMMAX (10^Number.MAX_VALUE; Doomed threshold varies with Divinities)
timeDimensionMultiplier.condition: Time Dimension multiplier reaches the second overflow threshold.
timeDimensionMultiplier.penalty: A second log-space compression with magnitude 10.

infinityPointMultiplierPurchases.starts: e3e6 (1e3,000,000 IP); delayed to ee125 by Endgame Upgrade 21 when Post-Reality is enabled
infinityPointMultiplierPurchases.condition: Repeatable 2x IP Mult purchases reach the cost-increase threshold.
infinityPointMultiplierPurchases.penalty: Cost growth per purchase changes from x10 to x1e10; cost is hardcapped at e6e6 IP.

eternitiesToInfinityDimensionMultiplier.penalty: The pre-cap Eternity count is limited to 100,000; excess Eternities use a slower multiplicative formula.

freeTickspeedUpgrades.starts: 300,000 upgrades; +100,000 from the Enslaved unlock, then multiplied by the V TScap reward
freeTickspeedUpgrades.penalty: The multiplier to the next upgrade grows by (1.000006)^(amount - softcap); costs use exponential scaling after the threshold.

replicanti.condition: Replicanti amount exceeds its current cap.
replicanti.penalty: Replication interval is multiplied by 10 and gains additional over-cap scaling based on amount above cap.

replicanti.condition: Pelle Eternity Strike is active and not destroyed; Replicanti are over cap.
replicanti.penalty: Adjusts the over-cap interval scaling to account for the strike's stronger slowdown.

glyphLevel.starts: 1500 + Effarig Glyph effect + Imaginary Upgrade 7 effect + Ra instability-delay effect
glyphLevel.condition: Scaled Glyph Level exceeds the regular instability threshold.
glyphLevel.penalty: For start S and rate R, level becomes S + R/2 * (sqrt(1 + 4*(level-S)/R) - 1); R=500.

glyphLevel.condition: Scaled Glyph Level exceeds the hyper-instability threshold after regular instability scaling.
glyphLevel.penalty: Same instability curve with rate R=400.

glyphLevel.starts: 1e5 Glyph Level; 1e6 when Glitch Reality Upgrade 14 is available for purchase
glyphLevel.condition: Scaled Glyph Level exceeds the Glitch instability threshold after regular and hyper instability.
glyphLevel.penalty: Same instability curve with rate 1e4; rate is x5 if Endgame Upgrade 13 is bought and Post-Reality is enabled.

glyphLevel.condition: Scaled Glyph Level exceeds the Chaos instability threshold after earlier instability stages.
glyphLevel.penalty: Same instability curve with rate R=250.

replicationGlyphEffect.condition: Combined Replication Speed Glyph effect exceeds the threshold.

singularityMilestoneCompletions.condition: Continuum Mult milestone raw completions exceed 20.
singularityMilestoneCompletions.penalty: Excess completions count at one third rate.

singularityMilestoneCompletions.condition: Dark Matter Mult milestone raw completions exceed 30.
singularityMilestoneCompletions.penalty: Excess completions count at one third rate.

singularityMilestoneCompletions.condition: Dark Energy Mult milestone raw completions exceed 10.
singularityMilestoneCompletions.penalty: Excess completions count at one third rate.

singularityMilestoneCompletions.condition: Dark Dimension Cost Reduction milestone raw completions exceed 25.
singularityMilestoneCompletions.penalty: Excess completions count at one third rate.

singularityMilestoneCompletions.condition: Singularity Mult milestone raw completions exceed 5.
singularityMilestoneCompletions.penalty: Excess completions count at one third rate.

singularityMilestoneCompletions.condition: Dark Dimension Interval Reduction milestone raw completions exceed 20.
singularityMilestoneCompletions.penalty: Excess completions count at one third rate.

singularityMilestoneCompletions.condition: Improved Ascension DM milestone raw completions exceed 15.
singularityMilestoneCompletions.penalty: Excess completions count at one third rate.

tesseractExtras.starts: 50 * Endgame Upgrade 23 effect * Ra free-Tesseract increase effect
tesseractExtras.condition: Owned Tesseracts plus other extra-Tesseract sources exceed the dynamic softcap start.
tesseractExtras.penalty: Extra above the start is divided by (1 + excess/start); after Alpha is destroyed, an additional logarithmic term applies.

darkMatterDimensionMultiplier.condition: Dark Matter Dimension power multiplier exceeds the threshold.
darkMatterDimensionMultiplier.penalty: For multiplier M and start S, use min(M,S) * 10^(log10(max(M/S,1))^0.9).

darkMatterDimensionMultiplier.condition: Dark Energy Dimension power multiplier exceeds the threshold.
darkMatterDimensionMultiplier.penalty: For multiplier M and start S, use min(M,S) * 10^(log10(max(M/S,1))^0.9).

celestialMatter.condition: Celestial Matter is generated; softcap applies above the calculated start.
celestialMatter.penalty: Above the start, excess is raised to 1/softcapPow; start and magnitude are affected by Endgame, Divinity, Ethereal, and Hepteract effects.

celestialMatter.condition: Celestial Matter exceeds the overflow threshold.

celestialMatter.penalty: Mass-overflow excess is raised to 1/MASS_OVERFLOW_MAG; Celestial Surge and Hepteracts modify the magnitude.

canteReplicatorMultiplier.penalty: Multiplier is divided by (amount/start)^(0.003 / Cante Upgrade 9 effect).
Multiplier is divided by (amount/start)^(0.05 / Cante Upgrade 9 effect).
Multiplier is divided by (amount/start)^(0.1 / Cante Upgrade 9 effect).
